name: Dutch Leningrad — Main Line
description: The aggressive Leningrad Dutch. Black plays an early ...g6 and fianchettos the bishop, aiming for a kingside attack and dynamic imbalance.

lines.name: Leningrad Variation — Main Line
lines.description: After 1.d4 f5 2.c4 Nf6 3.g3 g6, Black develops the bishop to g7. White usually plays Bg2 and Nf3. The position is sharp — Black seeks kingside play while White plays in the center and queenside.
